_comment: Activities the avatar can do. Each activity has options; each option has a duration in avatar hours (or "slider" for sleep), effects per avatar hour on GameState values, a background colour and an animation name. Effects only count for the time actually done. Options marked "placeholder": true use temporary numbers.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.comment: Duration comes from the sleep slider (config.json: sleep_activity, time.max_sleep_hours). No per-hour effect: when the sleep ends, its hours give the sleep score, and the sleep measure is worked out from it (config.json: measures_from_body).

cardio.name: Cardio
cardio.comment: calories_spent is in kcal per avatar hour, a record only. Cardio spends more calories than muscle strength. Fitness changes once per avatar day from the activity score (config.json: body_states).

strength.name: Muscle strength
strength.comment: calories_spent is a record only. Muscle changes once per avatar day from the strength score (config.json: body_states). There is no fatigue system.

entertainment.name: Entertainment
entertainment.comment: One option until the real entertainment menu is decided. It is logged as screen time and counts in the screens habit score; mood changes once per avatar day.
